# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers the wynn.tools web application. The data repository is out of scope.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email [scyu@scyu.dev](mailto:scyu@scyu.dev) with:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact

We aim to respond within 7 days. There is no bug bounty program.
